target_hypothesis: Top-5 most frequently >=80%-completed distinct airings; official Kaggle definition NOT confirmed

definitions.all_positive: Every programme with at least one >=80% completed airing in the window; unchanged old metric
definitions.top5_frequency: Distinct qualifying airing count descending, numeric programme ID ascending, retain <=5 per user; empty users contribute zero

methodology.cohorts: Fixed 4876 raw training-viewing users and all 1260 exact template users, independently reported
methodology.segments: Union overlapping viewing fragments per user-airing, clip observed seconds to snapshot, retain complete airing duration denominator
methodology.candidate_pool: 220, round-robin union of frequency, exposure10/80, recency, PPR, item neighbors, context, popularity; no target-guided insertion
methodology.neighbors: Meaningful >=50% coverage AND >=60 seconds; binary cosine co-viewing, no self-links, top80 neighbors; all historical users in graph
methodology.exposure: qualifying_view_weight=1 for each distinct >=80% airing; sum n80(user,item,channel)*future_airings(item,channel)/(past_airings(item,channel)+smoothing)
methodology.training: One fixed contextual LambdaRank configuration, trained on the same Top-5 target as evaluation; B is a score blend, not another architecture
methodology.selection: Mean submission-cohort Top5 MAP across two disjoint chronological backtests; prefer configurations improving both versus current PPR; original long split diagnostic only
caveats: Long main target overlaps both short backtests
Kaggle relevance definition and future viewing labels unavailable
Only the saved early-trained LightGBM can be fairly rescored before any training; production phase-six model contains validation labels and is excluded

code_changes.src/objective_alignment.py: Independent airing-fragment union, window coverage, distinct-frequency Top5 hypothesis, strength counters, smoothed exposure, top80 cosine neighbors, 220-candidate union, standalone anchors and stable blends
code_changes.scripts/phase08_align.py: Pre-training rescoring, dual-target and dual-cohort metrics, two disjoint chronological backtests, bounded selection, isolated Top5 LambdaRank refit, protected artifacts and validated exports
code_changes.tests/test_phase08_objective.py: Eight regression tests: overlap union, cutoff isolation, frequency ties, empty users, weak signals, exposure arithmetic, cosine normalization, score stability and row/label/group alignment

interpretation.conclusion: The all-positive metric is substantially more optimistic for the hypothesized Top5-frequency task. This magnitude supports objective mismatch as a plausible explanation, not confirmation of Kaggle semantics or expected Kaggle improvement.
interpretation.candidate_stop: The single 220-candidate pool raises main Top5 pair recall from 79.95% to 87.69%; no further expansion was attempted.
interpretation.strength_transform: Raw airing counters are computed first; count/seconds features use log1p and Float32 in the ranker. Weaker watches are never positive labels.
interpretation.selection_tradeoff: The 20% rank-normalized anchor blend slightly improves both short backtests versus A; A remains stronger on the long main diagnostic. Blend gains are small and may be noisy.
